title: Nightly event archiving
brief: Events older than 90 days move from events to events_archive every night, so the hot table stays small. Nothing may be lost: the archive is the audit record. Add jobs.ArchiveBefore(ctx, db, cutoff); the scheduler wiring is a later group.
tasks: Add jobs.ArchiveBefore moving old events into events_archive

expected.why: It deletes the old events BEFORE copying them, so the INSERT ... SELECT finds nothing: every run empties the rows it should archive and archives none.
A failed copy is logged and ArchiveBefore returns nil, so the caller reports success on a run that lost data.
